title: I'd like to gracefully stop this team

messages.text: I'd like to gracefully stop this team, i hope we will work together again.

Done. The team is stopped, with nothing lost. Thank you, it was a joy to work on this with you.

- Status board: my last three rows are closed. Every other row was already done or parked.
- No agents are running, and the hourly report is switched off.
- The open step (re-plug the iPhone) is cancelled. The Mac and phone locks are free.
- Stopped: 19 old test servers, the phone link (debug proxy, WebDriverAgent), and the USB and idle watchers.
- Still running for you: your mirror on port 5173 and this console, so you can read everything.
- Three old worktrees hold small unsaved edits. I left them as they are.
- Waiting on Fastwork: when they answer, start a new session and say "Fastwork answered". The release plan (step 5) says what goes public.
- Your work stays local: article, Medium kit, review sites and every commit.

What you need to do: nothing. I'll stop listening after this message.
